title: Sources and next note
summary: The note's end matter on graphite: every source in full as the kit's spec list, and the next note in the register (01 → 02 → 03 → 01) led by its symptom line, so a reader who finished can check the evidence or keep reading before the close asks anything.

reference.site: Approved Kelwin kit spec list (.ac-spec) and letter/S's field-note rows; /insights register symptom lines
reference.borrowed: The end matter of a published paper: the references in full, then where to read next.
reference.kelwin: Sources as the kit spec list (number · source · title · year ↗ · what the note takes from it, hedged as the source hedges it); the next note led by its symptom line in the accent voice, as /insights lists it, with the nav glyph of the layer it diagnoses.

motion: entrance: the two label rows fade, the source list and the next-note card rise (play-once with the slot).
interaction: hover on the source links (new tab, announced) and the next-note link.
on the live site: plays once as the slot scrolls in. Reduced motion: final state.
story: Closes the reading honestly: what the note rests on, hedged as each source hedges itself, then where to go next if the reader is still reading rather than buying.
copy: Sources [N glosses, K sources]: Gartner · The B2B buying journey · 2019 — every link re-verified before launch
Next note [N symptom line from the /insights register, K title/date/read time]: The 17% window (“Buyers can't retell you.”)
phone: ≤1023: the sources take the full width and the next note drops below them (cols 1–8). ≤767: one column; the spec keys narrow, the symptom line steps to 24px and the next-note link may wrap (long titles at 320).
notes: Paper → graphite needs no ruled seam. S and T have one source each, so their list is a single row; nothing is padded to look fuller. No red beyond the label square.
